title: fylgja twin show — the show block — M11 extension
description: The `show` block of the findings document `fylgja twin show --json` emits (operation twin.show). One document, from containerlab, the twin directory and the workflow service; every fact the text output reports, and no credential. M5: host.nodes[] gains artifact, the name and checksum twin.json records for the node, or null for a node the record does not name (an orphan’s, or a record that cannot be read). in_flight steps may be push. No artifact content. M7: host.nodes[] gains psp, the package id from twin.json, or null. M10: record gains waypoint, the waypoint twin.json 3 names, present only when the record names one; a 2 record shows none. The kind line for such a twin reads `pinned at <at>, waypoint <series>/<sequence>; not following`. M11: record gains state and step (the record's step block as twin show reads it: outcome, from, to, run, phase, restarted, pushed, timings, started_at, ended_at), present for a 4 record that has stepped; kind gains diverged, whose line names the target, the phase, the nodes landed and not, and fylgja twin destroy as the remedy; a stepped twin keeps kind pinned with a sentence naming the step; in_flight may list fylgja-step with its step. M12: record.step gains wait, the step's wait as twin show shows it: outcome, budget_s, reads, after_s and the failing assertions by rule and object (no message), or null while it has not run; absent for a 4 record. 014: record.waypoint becomes record.stage, the stage twin.json 6 names (its proposed change by id and branch, label, description, at_source), present only when the record names one; a 5 or earlier record shows none. The kind line reads `pinned at <at>, stage <branch>/<label>; not following`. record.step's sides carry stage where they carried waypoint. 015: record.rehearsal, the rehearsal run whose baseline the twin is, as twin.json 7 records it ({workflow_id, run_id}), present only when the record names one; a 6 or earlier record, or a 7 record of a twin no rehearsal built, shows none. in_flight may list fylgja-rehearse, its child the provision, step or destroy it has in flight, as a check's child is listed; the stage it is at is named by the text's in flight: line and by notes, not by the entry. 017: record.contract_version is gone, and record.scope and record.mapping ({reader, model, version}) carry twin.json 8's provenance, present for an 8 record that names a scope tag:<name> and a mapping twin.json 8 holds, and absent for a 7 or earlier one, which names neither, and for an 8 edited by hand to name a scope that is not tag:<name> or a mapping twin.json 8 cannot hold, which no build writes (T097, T106). The record line reads `record: <ref>, bundle_id <id>, schema <hash>, scope <scope>, read by <reader> from <model>@<version>`; `…, scope unknown (record <version>)` for a 7 or earlier record; `…, scope unknown (record 8 names scope "fylgja", not tag:<name>)` for an 8 whose scope is not tag:<name>; and `…, scope tag:fylgja, read by an unknown reader (record 8 names mapping reader "Infrahub DCIM")` for an 8 whose mapping twin.json 8 cannot hold, each field it fails named. 018: record.snapshot_id, required, the snapshot twin.json 9 names, or null for a 9 naming none and for a record of 8 or earlier; record.source gains snapshot, a twin twin create --snapshot built, whose kind is pinned or frozen by its envelope and never following, with the note `built from snapshot <id>`; record.step's sides carry snapshot_id when the record's step names one. The record line reads `record: <ref>, snapshot <id>, bundle_id <id>, schema <hash>, …`, with `snapshot none` for a 9 naming none and `snapshot none (record <version>)` for an earlier record. 019: a twin is frozen at its snapshot (D-062), so kind is none, snapshot, from_bundle or diverged: snapshot in place of pinned, frozen and following, for a twin from intent or a snapshot, whose kind line names the snapshot and, in brackets, its branch and its at, or the time it was read when it has none (`snapshot <short> (branch <b> at <t>)`, `snapshot <short> (branch <b>, read at <t>)`), then the stage, the step and the rehearsal as before; `snapshot none` for a record naming none, with the note that twin step refuses it. following, last_check and $defs/check are removed, and no line says pinned, frozen or following. Accepted pre-1.0 without a version move, as the findings document's; an earlier build's show block is held to the copy frozen under 018-snapshots/. 020: in_flight[].child is gone, since only fylgja-rehearse had a child and the rehearsal left the core's worker for the orchestrator (contracts/orchestrator.md); without a version move, pre-1.0 as at 019. From twin.json 12 the core's record names no stage and no rehearsal, which are the orchestrator's (D-065, D-066), and a record of 11 or earlier that names them is shown without them: record.stage and record.rehearsal are absent and each record.step side's stage is null for every twin of this build, the shapes kept for an earlier build's document, pre-1.0 without a version move.

artifact.description: M5: from twin.json, by node name; null when the record does not name the node.

psp.description: M7: the node’s support package id as twin.json records it (nodes[].psp.id), or null for a node the record does not name (an orphan’s). No new key in twin.json.

phrase.description: HostState.Describe(): what the host holds, in M3's words; empty when it holds nothing

record.description: twin.json, when present and readable; absent otherwise

at.description: verbatim, when the reference was pinned

snapshot_id.description: 018: the snapshot the record names, as twin.json 9's snapshot_id; null for a 9 naming none and for a record of 8 or earlier, whose record line says (record <version>), (record 8) for an 8

scope.description: 017: the scope the twin's read was made under, as twin.json 8's provenance.scope records it. Absent for a record of 7 or earlier, which names none, and for an 8 naming a scope that is not tag:<name> or a mapping twin.json 8 cannot hold, whose record line names it (T097, T106): present only beside mapping

mapping.description: 017: the reader that produced the twin's CTM and the version of the model it read, as twin.json 8's provenance.mapping records them. Absent for a record of 7 or earlier, which names none, and for an 8 naming a scope that is not tag:<name> or a mapping twin.json 8 cannot hold, whose record line names it (T097, T106): present only beside scope

stage.description: 014: the stage the twin was created from or stepped to, as twin.json 6 to 11 recorded it (twin.schema.json); absent when the record named none, and for a record of 5 or earlier. 020: absent for every twin of this build, since twin.json 12 names no stage (a stage is the orchestrator's, D-065, D-066) and a record of 11 or earlier that names one is shown without it; the shape kept, pre-1.0 without a version move

rehearsal.description: 015: the rehearsal run whose baseline the twin is, as twin.json 7 to 11 recorded it (twin.schema.json); absent when the record named none, and for a record of 6 or earlier. 020: absent for every twin of this build, since twin.json 12 names no rehearsal (the rehearsal is the orchestrator's twin-rehearse flow, D-065, D-066) and a record of 11 or earlier that names one is shown without it; the shape kept, pre-1.0 without a version move

state.description: M11: the record’s state; absent for a 3 record

step.description: M11: twin.json 4’s step block, as far as twin show shows it (twin.schema.json); absent when the record has no step

stage.description: 014: the side's stage, as twin.json 6 to 11's step block recorded it, or null. 020: null for every twin of this build, since twin.json 12's step block names no stage and a record of 11 or earlier that names one is shown without it; the shape kept, pre-1.0 without a version move

snapshot_id.description: 018: the side's snapshot, as twin.json 9's step block records it; absent when the side names none (the from side of a step from a record of 8)

stage.description: 014: the side's stage, as twin.json 6 to 11's step block recorded it, or null. 020: null for every twin of this build, since twin.json 12's step block names no stage and a record of 11 or earlier that names one is shown without it; the shape kept, pre-1.0 without a version move

snapshot_id.description: 018: the side's snapshot, as twin.json 9's step block records it; absent when the side names none (the from side of a step from a record of 8)

wait.description: M12: twin.json 5's step.wait as twin show shows it; null while the wait has not run; absent for a 4 record

notes.description: the statements the text prints: best-effort reproducibility for an unpinned twin; that a record naming no snapshot is not stepped, and the remedy; the remedy for an orphan; a run in flight that holds the host
